description: The window begins after the layer 1 expert all-gather. FSDP copy-out is fixed context; the puzzle covers only the activation-gradient path through EP and grouped expert backward.

Forward combine returns expert outputs to token owners. Its backward sends dY back to expert owners, matching the rank direction of forward dispatch. Forward dispatch's backward later returns dX to token owners, matching forward combine.
The local layout inverses remain necessary: unpermute backward recreates expert-major gradients before grouped expert backward, and permute backward prepares expert-input gradients for dX exchange.
